metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the kitchen, the sheet, the wrong bundle, and the prices written down.

yesterday: The frame is at seven. Twelve men. The ale after is the cousin's, and the twenty shillings is already out of the belt.
The orchard sheet was read. The girl stays as she was on Saturday night.
The shop had six pairs of sheep skins where the order was kid. You will walk them back after the frame. The bundle is on the bench.
Edmund is for school. Richard is the one who is believed about that.
